description.value:
Fried rice that is golden brown. Eating it almost feels like some punishment game.
Just looking at it fills you with determination.

"Of course, we can just casually cook up some fried rice..."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. Each creature first loses proficiency bonus hit points. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Strength increases by 1, maximum 20. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 15% of their Max HP and increases their ATK by 200 for the next battle.
